# The species catalogue
<!-- Generated by scripts/catalogue-pages.mjs. Do not edit; write in a species NOTES.md. -->

One folder per species, and the folder is the only place that species' record lives:
its bibliography, its admitted manifest, its packet, the pins the tests read, the
reference images the project may keep, and the owner's notes. A run under
`.flow/evidence/` refers to a species by its catalogue id and copies nothing out.

| Species | Scientific name | Architectural model | Preset | Sources | Verdict |

| [Norway spruce](norway-spruce/README.md) | Picea abies | not recorded | norway-spruce | 2 | unassessed |
